You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 207a3523b92d00eaca971c8b59cb729b0934f281 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Xinzheng Zhang <zhangxzheng@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Nov 2016 19:28:08 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] ff_ffplay: fix spell error introduced in de0927d64

---
 ijkmedia/ijkplayer/ff_ffplay.c     | 2 +-
 ijkmedia/ijkplayer/ff_ffplay_def.h | 4 ++--
 2 files changed, 3 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/ijkmedia/ijkplayer/ff_ffplay.c b/ijkmedia/ijkplayer/ff_ffplay.c
index eb72d6bb..c9c0970a 100755
--- a/ijkmedia/ijkplayer/ff_ffplay.c
+++ b/ijkmedia/ijkplayer/ff_ffplay.c
@@ -1193,7 +1193,7 @@ static int queue_picture(FFPlayer *ffp, AVFrame *src_frame, double pts, double d
         return -1;
 
     vp->sar = src_frame->sample_aspect_ratio;
-#if FFP_MERGE
+#ifdef FFP_MERGE
     vp->uploaded = 0;
 #endif
 
diff --git a/ijkmedia/ijkplayer/ff_ffplay_def.h b/ijkmedia/ijkplayer/ff_ffplay_def.h
index 9b041fc9..c4cf9326 100755
--- a/ijkmedia/ijkplayer/ff_ffplay_def.h
+++ b/ijkmedia/ijkplayer/ff_ffplay_def.h
@@ -192,7 +192,7 @@ typedef struct Frame {
     double pts;           /* presentation timestamp for the frame */
     double duration;      /* estimated duration of the frame */
     int64_t pos;          /* byte position of the frame in the input file */
-#ifdef FF_MERGE
+#ifdef FFP_MERGE
     SDL_Texture *bmp;
 #else
     SDL_VoutOverlay *bmp;
@@ -202,7 +202,7 @@ typedef struct Frame {
     int height;
     int format;
     AVRational sar;
-#ifdef FF_MERGE
+#ifdef FFP_MERGE
     int uploaded;
 #endif
 } Frame;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a typo in preprocessor directive macros. The incorrect macro `FF_MERGE` was used instead of the correct macro `FFP_MERGE`, which led to conditional compilation errors. This resulted in the code not being compiled as intended, affecting the functionality of the `queue_picture` function and how the `Frame` structure was treated in the code. The patch corrected the usage of the macro to maintain consistency and ensure proper compilation and function behavior.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a typo in preprocessor directive macros. The incorrect macro `FF_MERGE` was used instead of the correct macro `FFP_MERGE`, which led to conditional compilation errors. This resulted in the code not being compiled as intended, affecting the functionality of the `queue_picture` function and how the `Frame` structure was treated in the code. The patch corrected the usage of the macro to maintain consistency and ensure proper compilation and function behavior.
